name: recallradar
description: Consumer-product recalls and safety notices from CPSC, EU Safety Gate, RappelConso, Health Canada, UK OPSS, ACCC, BSMI and Tukes: search by product, brand or hazard, fetch one recall with its remedy and source links, and list the source registers with their licences. Keyless clients are answered from a published evaluation sample, rate-limited per IP; full access is available with a bearer token or per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: recalls_search
tools.description: Search recall notices by product, brand, hazard or keyword.

tools.name: recalls_get
tools.description: Fetch one recall with its remedy, recalling firms and source links.

tools.name: recalls_sources
tools.description: List the source registers with their licences and attribution rules.
